message.content:
For Synth Test (2020 Testcraft T5), here is what the admitted sources say:
**Synthetic Helmsynth HX90 service guide A > Spark plugs (Helmsynth HX90)**
- In this synthetic schedule the HX90 spark plugs are replaced every 100 engine hours. [1]
**Synthetic Helmsynth HX90 service guide B > Spark plugs (Helmsynth HX90)**
- In this synthetic schedule the HX90 spark plugs are replaced every 100 engine hours. [2]

The admitted sources I found disagree about the spark plug ([1] and [2]), so I can't give you a reliable answer on that.

Could you confirm your engine's exact model, year and serial number (or check with an authorised dealer) so I can narrow this down?

grounding.note: Admitted sources conflict on: spark plug. Cited sources include synthetic test fixtures — not real maintenance, safety or regulatory guidance.

citations.title: Synthetic Helmsynth HX90 service guide A
citations.excerpt: Guide A states that the synthetic spark plug code for the fictional Helmsynth HX90 outboard is SYN-PLUG-90A. In this synthetic schedule the HX90 spark plugs are replaced every 100 engine hours.

citations.excerpt: Guide B states that the synthetic spark plug code for the fictional Helmsynth HX90 outboard is SYN-PLUG-90B. In this synthetic schedule the HX90 spark plugs are replaced every 100 engine hours.
